evidence.description: FIND-101 FIXED: spec now contains '## F. Scheduling layer (HARD-2 — Inngest durable scheduler)' at line 67. REQ-31 (lines 68-70): durable cron SWEEPER per pass, FAN-OUT one event per user carrying ONLY { uid }, per-user fn re-fetches by uid. REQ-32 (71-72): Inngest concurrency key=event.data.uid so same-user jobs serialize. REQ-33 (73-76): SINGLE-WRITER — sweepers no-op (no fan-out) unless LIFE_RUN_LOOPS='false', C-H1 atomic claims (lm_wake_log/lm_travel_log/lm_ask_log) as additional idempotency. REQ-34 (77-78): /api/inngest fail-closed 503 in prod without INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY; dev (INNGEST_DEV=1) serves keyless.

REQ-31 ACCURATE: makeSweep*Handler list users (58,74,90) then sendEvent map (u)=>({name:'lm/wake.user',data:{uid:u.uid}}) (60-63,76-79,92-95) — only {uid}. Per-user handlers re-fetch via getUserByUid (112,128,141). REQ-32 ACCURATE: wakeUser/travelUser/askUser createFunction carry concurrency:{key:'event.data.uid',limit:1} (161,178,195). REQ-33 ACCURATE: inProcessLoopsOn(env) (37-40) → sweepers early-return BEFORE step.run/sendEvent when loops ON (57,73,89); only LIFE_RUN_LOOPS='false' fans out.
REQ-34 ACCURATE: inngestServeAllowed(env) (50-54) — dev(INNGEST_DEV=='1')→true else requires INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY; route returns 503 JSON (224-228) before inngestHandler (229) when not allowed.

REQ-33 claim ledgers REAL: claimWake (55) writes lm_wake_log; lm_travel_log/lm_ask_log referenced via lib/travel.js + lib/ask.js (grep-confirmed across server.js/scheduler.js/migrations/2026-06-24-ch1-atomic-dedup.sql). listPaidUsers=supaUsers alias (260-261); getUserByUid (267-278) re-fetches full row (uid,name,phone,paid,calendar_provider,home_address,gmail_account_id,telegram_chat_id,call_language[,wake_policy]) with same paid/phone/composio_gcal filter (271).

FIND-102 FIXED: makeWakeUserHandler captures the timestamp in its OWN memoized step — 'const nowMs = await step.run("now", () => Date.now());' (line 116) — BEFORE the side-effecting 'wake' step.run (line 117 'await step.run("wake", () => wakeOnce(u, nowMs))'). Date.now() is NO LONGER called inside the 'wake' step. On Inngest retry the 'now' step is memoized so the wake replay reuses the ORIGINAL handler time — no Date.now() drift inside the side-effecting step.

Memoized-time behavior is asserted at 245-268: wake-user handler invokes wakeUserOnce with a nowMs captured between before/after Date.now() (264-267). Handler-factory pattern remains clean; engines>=20 matches inngest@4.11.0 (carried from r2).
